scope: Tri-Evolve E2 dual-humanoid pillow-removal, blanket-canonicalization, two-fold, and bundle-transport video challenge
summary: Four frozen MiniMax-H3 BF16/50-step candidates completed across H0, H1, and H2 strategies. The predeclared exact-boundary adapter repaired the incumbent first-frame failure to SSIM 0.999535 for every candidate while preserving raw proposals. All four still failed the unchanged terminal-motion hard gate, so strict visual acceptance and physical promotion remain 0/4. One failed H0 GPU preflight was preserved and retried append-only on idle GPUs without changing its seed or contract.
evidence: Authoritative candidate terminal-flow maxima were 2.556299, 1.320522, 2.008730, and 5.735793 pixels under the frozen less-than-1.0-pixel veto
All four first-frame SSIM values were 0.999535 and frozen-background minimum SSIM ranged from 0.912938 to 0.960037 with zero detected hard cuts
lessons: A predeclared source-bound first-frame adapter can repair a systematic VAE boundary mismatch without relaxing the exact-frame gate or deleting raw evidence.
When H0, H1, and H2 all violate terminal dwell on the same frozen task, more seeds are not a justified remedy; the next change must alter temporal observability or task-duration architecture.
Photorealistic completion of obstacle clearing, folding, and transport in RGB does not establish force, collision safety, exact robot trajectories, or real execution.
limitations: Every candidate failed at least one automatic hard gate, so none advanced to candidate-SHA-bound native-resolution human acceptance.
The challenge has one generated scene/object group and no independently calibrated metric camera, q/qdot, cloth geometry, tactile/force, or recorded-hardware evidence.

The repository lacks scripts/compile_physical_video_plan.py, so the complete physical-video-planner standard entrypoint could not be invoked; the existing hash-bound Tri-Evolve components were used instead.
next_actions: Predeclare an architecture experiment with a longer terminal-dwell budget or endpoint-conditioned temporal controller while preserving every current hard gate.
Run at least one independent scene/object group and require all automatic gates before native-resolution human review.
Acquire calibrated real-robot trajectories and sensor contact evidence before making a physical-success claim.
